source_verification: Copied files match source SHA-256; source size and mtime unchanged after export

credential_scan.scope: training_backup contents; new files only, no claim about existing repository history

additional_credential_check: No long quoted literal assigned to key, token, password, secret or authorization fields found
restore_boundary: Local code and records copied; raw datasets, logs and external checkpoints must be restored from their source storage. Historical experiment claims are not fresh runtime verification.
source_format_preserved: Original files are copied byte for byte, including pre-existing trailing whitespace and terminal blank lines. New metadata is checked separately.
